## Description

Models simultaneous price jumps and order arrivals across multiple correlated assets using multivariate Hawkes point processes with jump diffusion components.

## Where it may fit

Flash crashes, scheduled macroeconomic news releases, sudden systemic liquidity crunches.

## Vehicles

High-frequency market makers, statistical arbitrage desks, algorithmic execution platforms.

## Required data

Tick-level trade timestamps, quote updates, order book depth messages across correlated assets.

## Caveats

Maximum likelihood estimation for multivariate kernels is computationally heavy and requires high-performance C++ extensions.
